title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-util-reporting-v40: smoother burst controls + utilization reporting
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: customers running Dedicated capacity observed instability during short traffic spikes — either overshooting throughput (leading to queueing) or overly aggressive throttling that reduced utilization. This PR smooths the burst controls and expands utilization reporting so SREs and customers can understand transient behaviour.

What I changed: unified token-bucket smoothing algorithm for the dedicated autoscaler; added an exponential moving average (EMA) of recent throughput and queue depth used for burst eligibility; introduced a new per-fleet metric 'dedicated.fleet.burst_utilization' and exported breakdowns by priority class; improved dashboard panels and added a lightweight sampling endpoint for recent burst events (used by the Console).

Scope: runtime autoscaler, fleet controller, metrics exporter, API surface (sampling endpoint), and dashboards. No model or customer-facing API shape changes.

Migration/rollout: feature-flagged behind `dedicated.autoscaler.smoothing.v2`. Default remains v1 for 48h; we will progressively enable for high-util fleets during the Canary window. Backward-compatible fallback included: if the smoothing state store is unavailable, autoscaler falls back to token-bucket v1 behavior.

Testing: unit tests for smoothing math and histogram bucketing; integration test exercising short spike scenarios in the perf-canary lab; local e2e against a simulated fleet with high-priority and low-priority routing. Benchmarks show 12-18% reduction in spike-induced queueing tail latency in our synthetic workload.

Monitoring & Alerting changes: new alert `HighBurstSmoothingDrop` when burst eligibility falls below threshold while enqueue rates are high; dashboards updated with per-fleet time-series and a histogram view of burst durations.

Related: Linear ENG-9421 (autoscaler reliability), ENG-9607 (observability for dedicated), SUP-443 (customer-reported incident).

Notes: kept change minimal in the hot path (most math is on the controller loop); added non-blocking writes for the smoothing state.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests
- [x] Integration tests
- [x] Benchmarks
- [x] Docs/console panels updated
- [x] Feature flag and rollback path
